_readme: Copy this to recon/booking-selectors.json and fill each value from a real
recon pass (recon/findings.txt + recon/booking-flow.json). The agent refuses
to book until vac_select, category_select, slot_row and reserve_button are set.
Several selectors accept a comma-separated fallback list, e.g. 'a, b'.
Keys prefixed with _ are ignored by the loader.
_deferred: reserve_endpoint/csrf_header are for the hybrid replay path; unused until the recon pass identifies the reserve call.
